title: [3.0-beta6] No Messages but Alarm by empty Battery and empty Reservoir
symptom: When the reservoir is empty or the battery is empty, there are no messages, only a signal tone is heard. A red triangle appears on the top left side, and when pressed, it shows 'Blood values are to near?!' The signal tone can only be turned off by restarting the smartphone.
cause: The pump (Dana-i) is not sending notifications to the phone when low battery or low reservoir occurs; it only beeps regularly. The red triangle is related to bad CGM data, not the reservoir/battery alarm.
fix: No fix is provided; the issue is confirmed as a limitation of the Dana-i pump not sending notifications to the phone. The red triangle is unrelated and indicates bad CGM data.
evidence_quote: i tested dana-i and can confirm that pump is not sending notification to phone but it beeps regulary on AAPS side you'll see red status light for reservoir on overview red triangel is related to bad CGM data
